meta.name: alfworld-object-transporter
meta.description: Picks up a target object from its current receptacle and moves it to a specified destination receptacle. Use when you have located an object and need to relocate it to complete a task (e.g., moving a laptop to a desk). Takes the object identifier, source receptacle, and destination receptacle as inputs and outputs the action sequence to take, transport, and place the object.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把指定物体从一个容器搬到另一个容器
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在虚拟环境中移动物体以完成任务
copy.tagline_en: Move a target object from one container to another
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to move objects in a virtual environment to complete tasks

howto.what: 让 Claude 能搬运物体：它会依次生成“前往源头→拿起物品→前往目标→放下物品”的指令，将指定物品从一个容器移到另一个容器。
howto.when: 当用户要求移动某个具体物体（如“把床上的笔记本电脑搬到书桌”）时，或者任务需要重新放置物品时触发。

say.text: 请把 laptop 1 从床 2 搬到书桌 1。
say.note: Claude 会生成导航、拿取、放置的步骤命令。

say.text: 将文件夹从椅子移到书架第二层。
say.note: Claude 会先确认物品位置再执行。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to perform object transport: it sequentially generates commands to navigate to source, take the object, navigate to destination, and place the object, moving a specified item from one receptacle to another.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests moving a specific object (e.g., "move the laptop on the bed to the desk") or when a task requires repositioning an item.

say_en.text: Move laptop 1 from bed 2 to desk 1.
say_en.note: Claude will output step-by-step navigation and manipulation commands.

say_en.text: Put the folder from the chair onto the bookshelf's second shelf.
say_en.note: Claude first verifies location then executes.
